scientific_integrity: Proof uses a logarithmic-potential Laplacian identity and two-sided margin-preserving perturbations; numerical diagnostics do not establish the continuum statement.
scientific_limitations: Existential positive small-exponent interval and fixed smooth perturbation; neither an explicit interval endpoint nor the global optimizer is determined. No claim about the known exponent-one optimizer.
title: A logarithmic-potential obstruction to the \(L_p\)-spherical energy conjecture
